title: Neuroprotective effects of rutin against cuprizone-induced multiple sclerosis in mice.
authors: Nicola, Mariam A; Attaai, Abdelraheim H; Abdel-Raheem, Mahmoud H; Mohammed, Anber F; Abu-Elhassan, Yasmin F
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芦丁对小鼠多发性硬化模型的神经保护作用，仅以分子对接初步涉及NF-kappaB蛋白-DNA结合位点，但核心为药效与湿实验，非TF-DNA互作建模研究。
abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic inflammatory neurodegenerative disease of the central nervous system that injures the myelin sheath, provoking progressive axonal degeneration and functional impairments. No efficient therapy is available at present to combat such insults, and hence, novel safe and effective alternatives for MS therapy are extremely required. Rutin (RUT) is a flavonoid that exhibits antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective effects in several brain injuries. The present study evaluated the potential beneficial effects of two doses of RUT in a model of pattern-III lesion of MS, in comparison to the conventional standard drug; dimethyl fumarate (DMF). Demyelination was induced in in male adult C57BL/6 mice by dietary 0.2% (w/w) cuprizone (CPZ) feeding for 6 consecutive weeks. Treated groups received either oral RUT (50 or 100 mg/kg) or DMF (15 mg/kg), along with CPZ feeding, for 6 consecutive weeks. Mice were then tested for behavioral changes, followed by biochemical analyses and histological examinations of the corpus callosum (CC). Results revealed that CPZ caused motor dysfunction, demyelination, and glial activation in demyelinated lesions, as well as significant oxidative stress, and proinflammatory cytokine elevation. Six weeks of RUT treatment significantly improved locomotor activity and motor coordination. Moreover, RUT considerably improved remyelination in the CC of CPZ + RUT-treated mice, as revealed by luxol fast blue staining and transmission electron microscopy. Rutin also significantly attenuated CPZ-induced oxidative stress and inflammation in the CC of tested animals. The effect of RUT100 was obviously more marked than either that of DMF, regarding most of the tested parameters, or even its smaller tested dose. In silico docking revealed that RUT binds tightly within NF-kappaB at the binding site of the protein-DNA complex, with a good negative score of -6.79 kcal/mol. Also, RUT-Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) model clarifies the possible inhibition of Keap1-Nrf2 protein-protein interaction. Findings of the current study provide evidence for the protective effect of RUT in CPZ-induced demyelination and behavioral dysfunction in mice, possibly by modulating NF-kappaB and Nrf2 signaling pathways. The present study may be one of the first to indicate a pro-remyelinating effect for RUT, which might represent a potential additive benefit in treating MS.
abstract_zh: 多发性硬化症（multiple sclerosis, MS）是一种中枢神经系统的慢性炎症性神经退行性疾病，损伤髓鞘，导致进行性轴突变性和功能障碍。目前尚无有效疗法应对此类损伤，因此亟需开发新型安全有效的MS治疗替代方案。芦丁（Rutin, RUT）是一种黄酮类化合物，在多种脑损伤中表现出抗氧化、抗炎和神经保护作用。本研究评估了两种剂量的RUT在MS III型病变模型中的潜在有益效果，并与常规标准药物富马酸二甲酯（dimethyl fumarate, DMF）进行比较。通过连续6周饲喂含0.2%（w/w）双环己酮草酰二腙（cuprizone, CPZ）的饮食，在成年雄性C57BL/6小鼠中诱导脱髓鞘。治疗组分别口服RUT（50或100 mg/kg）或DMF（15 mg/kg），同时饲喂CPZ，持续6周。随后对小鼠进行行为学变化测试，并对胼胝体（corpus callosum, CC）进行生化分析和组织学检查。结果显示，CPZ导致运动功能障碍、脱髓鞘和脱髓鞘病变中的胶质细胞活化，以及显著的氧化应激和促炎细胞因子升高。六周RUT治疗显著改善了运动活性和运动协调性。此外，RUT显著改善了CPZ + RUT处理小鼠CC中的再髓鞘化，这通过劳克坚牢蓝染色和透射电子显微镜得以证实。芦丁还显著减轻了受试动物CC中CPZ诱导的氧化应激和炎症。在大多数测试参数方面，RUT100的效果明显优于DMF，也优于其较低测试剂量。计算机模拟对接显示，RUT在蛋白-DNA复合物的结合位点处与NF-kappaB紧密结合，负评分良好，为-6.79 kcal/mol。此外，RUT-Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）模型阐明了其对Keap1-Nrf2蛋白-蛋白相互作用的可能抑制作用。本研究结果为RUT在CPZ诱导的小鼠脱髓鞘和行为功能障碍中的保护作用提供了证据，可能通过调节NF-kappaB和Nrf2信号通路实现。本研究可能是首批表明RUT具有促再髓鞘化作用的研究之一，这可能代表其在治疗MS中具有潜在的附加益处。
